wins: Confirmed consistent reconnaissance coverage across target by running targeted port scans, yielding high-reward data even without full mission success.
Maintained disciplined logging/reporting cadence across mentor interactions (10 calls) to maximize visibility for remediation-focused feedback.
fails: Unable to achieve mission success (0% success rate) indicating that post-scan actions such as exploitation or privilege escalation stalled.
Session management failed to persist beyond initial probing, preventing follow-on exploitation or data exfiltration.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase delivered repeatable intelligence (reward 70), but execution blocked at exploitation/persistence stage, so next steps must expand on actionable follow-ons from enumeration data.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-enumeration execution stopped because credential validation or exploitation was never attempted after port/service discovery.

skill_cards.if_condition: When a previously unknown service responds on TCP/22 with an SSH banner
skill_cards.then_action: Conduct SSH enumeration using Nmap with SSH scripts to collect supported algorithms and authentication methods

skill_cards.if_condition: When service banners are collected from enumeration
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot to banner-specific exploitation planning (check for outdated versions or misconfigurations via CVE search)

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance yields high-value hosts but session persistence is lacking
skill_cards.then_action: Schedule immediate credential harvesting (e.g., Hydra/Medusa) or brute-force follow-up to secure initial foothold while the host is accessible

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase

next_experiments.title: Structured Exploitation Playbook
next_experiments.description: Use enumeration output to map services to known CVEs and attempt targeted exploitation (Metasploit auxiliary/exploit modules) while capturing all output.

next_experiments.title: Credential Harvesting Run
next_experiments.description: Launch Hydra against discovered services with curated username/password lists to gain an initial shell; prioritize protocols with valid banners.

next_experiments.title: Session Persistence Verification
next_experiments.description: After establishing access, test persistence techniques (e.g., scheduled tasks, cron jobs) to confirm ability to maintain foothold beyond a single session.
